name: ReviewCarousel
usage_hint: Rotating customer review showcase with star ratings, typically placed below product info or before FAQ on PDPs. Supports static reviews array or runtime fetch from our reviews API.
when_to_use: When you have 3+ customer reviews to display and want to build trust through social proof. Supports two modes: static reviews array (baked in) or fetch mode (reviewsEndpoint + productIds for live data from our API).
when_not_to_use: For single reviews (just show the review card directly). For real-time streaming review feeds (this fetches a batch, not a live stream).
anti_patterns: Passing more than 12 reviews in static mode (carousel becomes too long; pre-filter to top reviews by rating/helpfulness)
Using minimal variant with long review bodies (text doesn't truncate well; use grid or default instead)
Setting interval below 3000ms (users can't read reviews; keep it ≥4000ms)
Mixing verified and unverified reviews without the verified flag (damages trust; always mark verified purchases)
Using both reviews[] and reviewsEndpoint (reviews[] takes priority; pick one mode)

examples.label: Default carousel with 4 reviews (autoplay, 5s interval)
examples.source:
<lx-island name="ReviewCarousel">
  <script type="application/json">{"reviews":[{"author":"Sarah M.","rating":5,"body":"Absolutely love this product! Quality exceeded my expectations and shipping was super fast.","date":"2 weeks ago","verified":true},{"author":"Mike R.","rating":4,"body":"Great value for money. Minor issue with packaging but product itself is perfect.","date":"1 month ago","verified":true},{"author":"Emma L.","rating":5,"body":"This is my third purchase. Consistent quality every time. Highly recommend!","date":"3 days ago","verified":true,"avatar":"/avatars/emma.jpg"},{"author":"David K.","rating":5,"body":"Best decision I made this year. Customer service was also incredibly helpful.","date":"1 week ago","verified":true}],"autoplay":true,"interval":5000,"variant":"default"}</script>
</lx-island>
